pages.text: $(thing)Bowls$() are a versatile tool which can be used to make $(l:mechanics/salad)Salads$(), to make $(l:mechanics/pot)Soups$(), to $(l:mechanics/decay#salting)Salt$() meat, or to apply $(thing)Powder$() to $(l:mechanics/glassworking_applications#coloring)Glass$() in order to change the resulting glass's color.$(br2)Bowls can be made both from $(thing)Ceramic$(), by knapping a bowl out of clay, and then firing them.
Multiple unfired bowls can be made from one knapping.

Bowls can also be made out of wood via crafting them together with $(thing)Glue$()$(br2)$(thing)Glue$() can be made by soaking $(thing)Bone Meal$() in a barrel of $(l:mechanics/barrels#limewater)Limewater$().
pages.title: Wooden Bowls

pages.text: Bowls can also be placed on the ground like blocks. When placed, they can be filled with any type of $(thing)Powder$() - the results of grinding ores, minerals, or gems in the $(l:mechanics/quern)Quern$().

The Powder Bowl can hold up to 16 of a given powder. To insert items, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() while holding the powder. To extract items, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with an empty hand.$(br2)$(item)$(k:key.sneak)$() allows extracting the entire contents of the bowl.
pages.title: Powders

pages.text: If there is salt in the bowl, clicking with unsalted raw meat will salt the meat. This is the same as crafting the meat with the salt in your inventory.
